caption: The drawing depicts a single, headless mannequin dressed in a historical-style outfit. The mannequin is wearing a long, full-skirted dress in a rich pink color with wavy and floral gold patterns running vertically down the length of the fabric. The dress features a fitted bodice with puffed shorter sleeves, and it is tied at the waist with a wide sash or belt in a matching pink shade. Tied around the neck is a white lace collar, and the mannequin wears a prominent blue bonnet with red ribbons. The bonnet has a broad brim and covers where the face would be, with additional red ribbon accents visible at the top and sides. The background is a plain, light beige color, and the mannequin stands on a dark oval base. There are no other objects or elements in the drawing.
title: Doorstop Doll
